author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: নির্দেশিত শব্দটি কোন parts of speech তা বেছে নাও।

items.q: In 'He runs fast', what part of speech is 'fast'?
In 'The water is cold', what part of speech is 'water'?
In 'She is very kind', what part of speech is 'very'?
In 'He and I are friends', what part of speech is 'and'?
items.rule_bn: দুটি শব্দ যুক্ত করছে, তাই conjunction।

items.q: In 'Wow, what a goal!', what part of speech is 'Wow'?
In 'This is my book', what part of speech is 'my'?
In 'The bird sits on the branch', what part of speech is 'on'?
items.rule_bn: noun-এর সাথে সম্পর্ক বোঝাচ্ছে, তাই preposition।

items.q: In 'He works hard', what part of speech is 'works'?
